lines: - Cache the hash of an AST node (`ASTHasher::hash()`) in a `WeakMap` instead of a dynamic property of the node. PHP allocates a property table of 376 bytes for the first dynamic property of an object, and the hash was the only dynamic property of most of the nodes that had one: in Phan's analysis of itself, 27 % of the nodes of an analyzed file had a dynamic property, and 5 % do now. The saving in peak memory is small (2 MB of 724 MB for that run), because few of those nodes are alive at the same time. A modified clone of a hashed node no longer keeps the hash of the original node ([#5638](https://github.com/phan/phan/issues/5638))

+- Update the signatures of internal functions and methods to match PHP 8.1 through 8.6, which fixes false positives such as `PhanParamTooManyInternal` for `strrchr($h, $n, true)` (PHP 8.3), `hash_file(..., $options)` or `grapheme_strpos(..., locale: ...)`, `PhanParamTooFewInternal` for `IntlChar::forDigit($digit)` or `IntlDateFormatter::create($locale)`, and wrong named arguments such as `Phar::copy(from: ..., to: ...)`. About 200 functions and methods had missing, extra or renamed parameters, parameters that were wrongly optional or required, or return types that contradicted PHP (e.g. `ArrayObject::asort()` and the other sorting methods of `ArrayObject` and `ArrayIterator` were `void` instead of `bool`, `SplObjectStorage::removeAll()` was `void` instead of `int`, `SplDoublyLinkedList::unshift()` was `bool` instead of `void`), and parameter types that rejected values PHP accepts (e.g. `ArrayIterator::setFlags()` took `string` instead of `int`, `mysqli_stmt::__construct()` took `string` instead of `mysqli`, `imagestring()` and the other GD font functions did not accept `GdFont`, and `openssl_cms_encrypt()` does not accept a cipher name before PHP 8.5). `Phar::offsetGet()` and `PharData::offsetGet()` return `PharFileInfo`, `PhpToken::tokenize()` returns `list<static>`, `XMLReader::open()` and `XMLReader::XML()` return `XMLReader|bool` (an `XMLReader` when called statically), and `SplHeap` and `SplPriorityQueue` have `__serialize()` and `__unserialize()` (PHP 8.6). Return types that included a failure value PHP does not return are corrected (e.g. `IntlDateFormatter::create()`, `NumberFormatter::create()` and `IntlTimeZone::createTimeZone()` return `null` instead of `false`, and `SplFileObject::fgets()` and `DOMDocument::createTextNode()` do not return `false`). `mb_convert_encoding()` returns an array for an array
+- Fix the names of by-reference variadic parameters of internal functions such as `sscanf()` and `mb_convert_variables()` (`$vars` instead of `$w_vars`)

- Fix crashes, a hang and internal exceptions found by running Phan on the test suites of php-src, Psalm and PHPStan. Phan now analyzes the following without crashing (it does not yet report all of them as errors):
- circular inheritance such as `class A extends B {}` with `class B extends A {}` (infinite recursion)

- `\static` as a return type, `parent&Iterator` in a trait, `@return X&static` called on an intersection type, `self&B` in the phpdoc of a class constant, `value-of<T>` iterated with `foreach`, and `@extends`, `@implements` or `@use` with a type that is not a class (e.g. `class-string<T>`)

- Fix `PhanIncompatibleCompositionConstant` for the constants that a trait gets from the traits it uses, which were not checked: they are now checked against the constants of the class using the trait, of its other traits and (before PHP 8.5) of its parent class, as PHP does ("P and Outer define the same constant (C) in the composition of Ch"). Fix false positive `PhanIncompatibleCompositionConstant` for constants with the same value on different lines, such as `[1, 2]`, `null` or `1 + 1` in two traits: the values were compared with their line numbers. Phan now evaluates the values and compares them with `===`, as PHP does, so `1 + 1` and `2`, or `self::A` and `1` when `A` is 1, are compatible, and `[1, 2]` and `[1 => 2, 0 => 1]`, `1` and `1.0`, or an enum case and its backing value are not. `self` in the value of a constant of a trait is the class using the trait. An int value of a constant whose declared type accepts `float` and not `int` is a float, as in PHP (`const float C = 1;` is `1.0`). A value that accesses a constant through a trait (`T::X`, or `self::X` in a trait that uses other traits) is reported, because PHP throws an Error when it evaluates it. `X::class` is the name that PHP gives, resolved with the namespace and the `use` statements (the class does not have to exist), and the integer operators (`%`, `|`, `&`, `^`, `<<`, `>>` and `~`) are evaluated for integers. Values that Phan does not evaluate are not reported: global constants other than `null`, `true` and `false` (`namespace\true` is a constant of the namespace), magic constants other than `__LINE__`, the integer operators for operands that are not integers, operations that throw (such as `%` by zero), operators applied to a class name that Phan resolves through a `use` statement, `self` or `parent` (it may know the name with other letters in uppercase than PHP), a value with a class constant that the declared type converts to float (PHP converts it only if it replaced the class constant at compile time), the value of a constant inherited from the parent class if it depends on the class that `self` is (PHP evaluates it in the scope of the class or of the parent class, depending on whether it evaluated it before), large arrays of literals of which Phan keeps only some elements (`ast_trim_max_elements_per_level`, `ast_trim_max_total_elements`), values that would take Phan more than 3000 steps to evaluate (a constant is evaluated again for each reference to it), and some expressions, such as `?:` and `self::X[0]`. Fix false positive `PhanConstantTypeMismatchInheritance` for a constant declared as `iterable` that overrides a constant declared as `array|\Traversable` (e.g. `?iterable` and `array|\Traversable|null`), which PHP 8.3+ accepts ([#5661](https://github.com/phan/phan/issues/5661))

+- Add `internal/check_signature_map_against_reflection.php` and `internal/update_signature_map_from_reflection.php`, which compare the signature map of each PHP version with Reflection and update it (run with each PHP version from 8.1 to the newest in order), and `internal/lib/SignatureReflectionCheckPlugin.php`, which compares the signatures that Phan loads from the map, the bundled stubs and Reflection

- The PHPUnit test suite runs in a third of the time: the file tests collect PHP's reference cycles once the heap has grown by 64 MB instead of after every test ([#5626](https://github.com/phan/phan/issues/5626))

- Remove the unmaintained Code Climate engine (`plugins/codeclimate/`): its Dockerfile built on PHP 8.0 with php-ast 1.0.16 and could no longer install Phan's dependencies, and no image is published for it. The `codeclimate` output format is unaffected
